phase: Phase 2: The print-audit block and the overview table (by Wed 2026-11-18)
summary: Phase 2 production contract holds: model-guide.json (schema model-guide-overview/1, six D18 rows, exact keys) and print-audit-2026-11.json (52 errors, 13 blockers, OD6 SHA-256 f52a7bbf verified against the real hand-off file) match spec D17/D18 and the Q1, Q2, and 2.4a rulings; the preview pages agree with the JSON byte-for-byte in content, the no-pick and evidence wording is exact, update.sh meets D19, and no model_guide commit wrote under docs/. Task 2.8 is the open check task of this phase and is not counted as a finding. Six nonblocking items: untested page branches (stale mark, table position, section dedupe), the spec Q6 label default versus the 2.4a route-name ruling, a latent track A tie-break deviation from D13, alphabetical newest-score-file selection, and the unused plan marker-comment note.
nonblocking_findings: P2C1-1 [Nit] review-c: The D19 page stale mark has no test. guide.test.ts T6 (line 516) pins only the JSON stale boolean at the 14/15-day boundary; the overview_stale render branch of preview.sh (lines 320-326, paragraph with data-stale="true") is exercised by no test and not by the real preview (model-guide.json holds stale:false). Rationale: a spec clause of the page contract (D19 'shows the mark stale') has no failing-first test, and a regression in the branch would ship silently.

P2C1-2 [Nit] review-c: The D18/acceptance-7 position clause ('shows it first, above the current hero') and the five column header texts have no automated test. No test file references id="model-guide", the hero anchor, or the headers 'Kind of work'/'Use this model'/'Second choice'/'Evidence'/'Evidence date'; plan 2.6's 'a second preview over a published index keeps one section' is also untested (preview-gate C3-2 covers only nav links). Current correctness is shown only by the real preview (index.html: section at line 28, hero at line 55) and the manual record preview-2.9.txt. Rationale: page-contract clauses rest on a manual record instead of a test.

P2C1-3 [Nit] review-c: Spec Q6's default ('the page shows the PM label k3.1-pro and names no route') conflicts with the binding 2.4a ruling output. The data file and the real-work.html block name full routes: 'kimi-code-plan-cn/k3.1-pro 11 of 13; claude-code/claude-sonnet-5-5#high 13 of 13'. The implementation follows the 2.4a ruling recorded in plan.md (routes maps the route name to blockers_found of summary.key.blockers); spec.md D17/Q6 was never updated to record the ruling. Rationale: spec and page diverge on the label wording; the owner of spec.md should record the 2.4a ruling at D17/Q6 or the PM should answer Q6.

P2C1-4 [Nit] review-c: The track A tie-break in guide.ts deviates from D13. readTrackARank sorts by worst score descending then route name ascending (guide.ts line 241); D13 breaks a tie by the higher worst blocker recall and then the higher median score, and D18 names 'track A rank (worst of N)' as the Code review source. No test covers two routes with an equal worst score. Rationale: in Phase 4 a tie could make the overview pick differ from the review.html rank order.

P2C1-5 [Nit] review-c: 'Newest review score file' is the alphabetically last glob match, not the newest by date, in preview.sh (lines 126-130) and update.sh (lines 61-65). No review-scores folder exists in Phase 2, so behavior is correct now; in Phase 4 a pilot file (mg-2026-11p*) sorts after the ranked file (mg-2026-11a) and would win. Rationale: latent wiring defect for the Phase 4 integration.

P2C1-6 [Nit] review-c: The plan.md file-map note says the overview block goes between <!-- model-guide:start --> and <!-- model-guide:end --> after </nav>; the implementation inserts the section at the '<header class="hero' anchor and dedupes by id="model-guide", and no marker comments exist in docs/index.html or the preview. The placement contract itself holds (section directly after </nav> at line 26, above the hero at line 55). Rationale: plan.md wiring note diverges from the shipped mechanism; the note should be updated before Phase 5 publish work relies on it.
